wiki.title: Anthony Lucas (defensive end)
wiki.intro: Anthony Lucas (born October 8, 2004) is an American professional football defensive end for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies and USC Trojans. Lucas was signed by the Lions as an undrafted free agent following the 2026 NFL draft.

sections.title: Early life
sections.text: Lucas attended Chaparral High School in Scottsdale, Arizona. He had 29 tackles with six sacks his junior year and 64 tackles with 9.5 sacks his senior year. Lucas was selected to play in the 2022 Under Armour All-American Game. A five-star recruit, he committed to Texas A&M University to play college football.

sections.title: College career
sections.text: In his lone season at Texas A&M his true freshman year in 2022, Lucas played in seven games and had 10 tackles. After the season, he transferred to the University of Southern California (USC). In his first year at USC in 2023, he played in all 13 games with one start and had 10 tackles. Lucas started the first six games of his junior year in 2024, before suffering a season-ending injury. For the season he had 16 tackles. Lucas returned to USC for his senior year in 2025.

sections.title: Professional career
sections.text: Lucas was signed as an undrafted free agent by the Detroit Lions after the conclusion of the 2026 NFL draft. On August 30, 2026, Lucas was waived by Detroit as a part of final roster cuts; he was re-signed to the team's practice squad the following day.

transactions.text: Placed LB Jack Campbell on injured reserve. Signed DB Nick Whiteside to the active roster. Elevated DE Anthony Lucas and RB Jabari Small from the practice squad.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
